subject: how unspent per-phase accelerator-hours are treated

rule.statement: A per-phase ceiling constrains spending WITHIN that phase. Unspent balance returns to a shared reserve. The 240 actively used GPU-hour global ceiling is the only hard stop.
rule.drawing_on_the_reserve_requires: an explicit journal record naming the source phase and the amount

rationale.why_not_forfeit_unspent_hours: Forfeiting would artificially starve P-4, whose 72-hour allocation is the largest and whose work - JA for every candidate feature, three-layer motor exclusion, matched control construction - is the most expensive in the plan. Starving it for bookkeeping reasons would degrade the study for no governance benefit.
rationale.why_240_is_the_right_binding_number: 240 is the quantity the operator actually approved. The per-phase figures are a plan for spending it, not seven separate approvals.
rationale.what_this_does_not_do: It does not raise any ceiling, does not create hours that were never approved, and does not weaken the fail-closed stop at 240.

claim_ceiling: This is an accounting rule. It licenses no claim of any kind.
